event_lengths_chk.name: event_lengths_chk
event_lengths_chk.value: char_length("event"."title") between 1 and 120 and char_length("event"."description") <= 1500 and char_length("event"."venue_name") between 1 and 120 and char_length("event"."address") <= 300 and ("event"."contact_email" is null or char_length("event"."contact_email") <= 200)

event_hidden_chk.name: event_hidden_chk
event_hidden_chk.value: ("event"."hidden_at" is null) = ("event"."hidden_reason" is null) and ("event"."hidden_reason" is null or char_length("event"."hidden_reason") <= 200)

faq_ask_lengths_chk.name: faq_ask_lengths_chk
faq_ask_lengths_chk.value: char_length("faq_ask"."question") <= 300 and ("faq_ask"."answer" is null or char_length("faq_ask"."answer") <= 600)

faq_entry_lengths_chk.name: faq_entry_lengths_chk
faq_entry_lengths_chk.value: char_length("faq_entry"."question") between 1 and 200 and char_length("faq_entry"."answer") between 1 and 800

ticket_names_chk.name: ticket_names_chk
ticket_names_chk.value: char_length("ticket"."holder_name") between 1 and 80 and ("ticket"."guest_label" is null or char_length("ticket"."guest_label") <= 40)
